BRANDING / 04 OF 05

Domina

Confidence, by design.

A considered visual language for Domina by Pee Safe, encouraging a more open conversation about sexual wellness.

THE PROJECT

The idea behind the identity.

Domina encourages women to take charge of their sexual wellness and talk about it without fear or shame. The design supports that message with confident typography, a soft lavender palette and clear product communication.

DESIGN DIRECTION

Less taboo. More confidence.

The aim was to move beyond clichés and make the subject feel approachable. A restrained visual system allows the products and their purpose to take centre stage, with a tone that feels direct, respectful and self-assured.

THE VISUAL LANGUAGE

Colour sets the tone.

Soft White#F7F7F7
Charcoal#262626
Lavender#EACCEF
TYPOGRAPHY

Spartan SemiBold

A confident heading style with clean geometric forms.

TYPOGRAPHY

Spartan Regular

A lighter supporting style for clear, readable communication.

IN APPLICATION

A consistent product family.

Lavender and deep purple connect the product visuals, while simple compositions keep the focus on the range. Each image has space to communicate clearly within the wider identity.
